text: 近期，资金借道宽基ETF（交易型开放式指数基金）积极布局A股市场。万得数据显示，10月22日，全市场宽基ETF单日净流入516.55亿元。将时间拉长至近20个交易日（9月17日至10月22日）来看，股票型ETF累计净流入2496.59亿元，其中宽基ETF净流入2361.41亿元，占比达94.59%。从具体产品来看，资金主要流向沪深300、科创50、创业板等指数相关ETF。（证券日报）
text_en: Recently, funds have actively positioned in the A-share market through broad-based ETFs (exchange-traded funds). Wind data shows that on October 22, broad-based ETFs across the market saw a single-day net inflow of 51.655 billion yuan. Looking at the past 20 trading days (September 17 to October 22), equity ETFs recorded a cumulative net inflow of 249.659 billion yuan, of which broad-based ETFs saw a net inflow of 236.141 billion yuan, accounting for 94.59%. By specific product, funds mainly flowed into ETFs linked to indices such as the CSI 300, STAR 50 and ChiNext. (Securities Daily)
